label: Visual
definition: The sensory modality that pertains to the sense of sight.

label: Auditory
definition: The sensory modality that pertains to the sense of hearing.

label: Tactile
definition: The sensory modality pertaining to the sense of contact via the skin with external objects.

label: Olfactory
definition: The sensory modality pertaining to the sense of smell.

label: Gustatory
definition: The sensory modality pertaining to the sense of taste or flavor.

label: Interoceptive
definition: The sensory modality that pertains to the sense of interoception, or internal sensations.
hed_note: HED 8.4.0 has Somatic-presentation and Vestibular-presentation but no interoceptive presentation tag.

label: Electrical
definition: The sensory modality that pertains to the sense of electric shock; a subtype of tactile in CogPO.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED has no electrical modality.

label: Pain
definition: The subtype of tactile modality that pertains to the sense of pain.
hed_note: Pain is a Somatic-attribute, so it qualifies the presentation rather than naming a modality.

label: Pressure
definition: The tactile modality that pertains to the sense of non-painful touch.

label: Thermal
definition: The sensory modality that pertains to the sense of heat applied to the skin.

label: 3D objects
definition: An object with height, width, length and mass given to the participant to hold.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED's 3D-shape is a geometric object, and a real handheld object has no closer item.

label: Abstract patterns
definition: Complex, abstract, geometrical patterns.

label: Acupuncture
definition: Piercing of specific body areas with fine needles.
hed_note: No HED item; out of the Catalog's scope in any case.

label: Asian characters
definition: Logograms taken from an Asian language such as Chinese, Japanese or Korean.
hed_note: HED's Character is any written character and does not distinguish scripts.

label: Braille dots
definition: Combinations of tangible dots representing letters or characters, read by touch.

label: Breathable gas
definition: A stimulus consisting of a breathable gaseous material.

label: Chord sequences
definition: A three-note chord accompaniment (major triads, dominant sevenths and so on).
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED has no chord item.

label: Clicks
definition: Repeated ticking sounds made by a mechanical or electrical instrument at a given frequency.

label: Digits
definition: Any of the Arabic figures 1 through 9 and 0.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED has no digit item. The numeric value itself is a data value, not an item.

label: Electrical stimulation
definition: A stimulus applied to the skin or muscle using a current pulse (OWL label: Electronic Stimulations).
hed_note: No HED item; Somatic-presentation names the modality only.

label: Eye puffs
definition: A puff of air delivered to the eye.
hed_note: No HED item; Tactile-presentation names the modality only.

label: Faces
definition: A representation of the front of the human head, from forehead to chin.

label: False fonts
definition: Letter-like meaningless signs.

label: Film clips
definition: Audiovisual presentation of a motion-picture film.
hed_note: Video-clip is the media clip; Movie the work it comes from.

label: Fixation point
definition: A point or crosshair on which to fixate attention.
hed_note: HED has no fixation-point item; the usual annotation is a Cross with the Fixate action.

label: Flashing checkerboard
definition: Contrast-reversed checkerboards oscillating at a specified frequency, generally black and white.
hed_note: Nearest tag; no checkerboard item. Luminance-contrast can carry the reversal.

label: Food
definition: Any nourishing substance that is eaten, drunk or otherwise ingested.
hed_note: No HED item; Gustatory-presentation names the modality only.

label: Fractals
definition: A complex geometric pattern exhibiting self-similarity.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED's Fractal is a data-variability attribute, not an item.

label: Heat
definition: Stimuli which create the sensation of warmth or hotness.
hed_note: An attribute rather than an item.

label: Infrared laser
definition: A laser stimulus emitting near-infrared radiation.

label: Infusion
definition: The introduction of a liquid solution such as saline into a vein.

label: Letters
definition: A symbol or character used in writing to represent a speech sound and part of an alphabet.
hed_note: HED's Letter is a document (correspondence), so Character is the tag for an alphabetic letter.

label: Music
definition: Organized tones or sounds in melody or harmony, from voices or instruments.

label: Noise
definition: A group of sounds with a broad distribution of intensities across a wide range of frequencies.

label: Nonverbal vocal sounds
definition: Non-word human vocalizations such as sighing, crying, screams or laughter.

label: Nonvocal sounds
definition: Sounds produced by animals, machines, nature or objects.
hed_note: Named-animal-sound and Named-object-sound are its children.

label: Odor
definition: A sensation perceived by the sense of smell; a scent.
hed_note: No HED item; Olfactory-presentation names the modality only.

label: Pain
definition: A physically distressing sensation in a particular part of the body (wiki label: Painful Stimulation).
hed_note: A Somatic-attribute rather than an item.

label: Pictures
definition: A representation or image painted, drawn, photographed or otherwise rendered on a flat surface.
hed_note: Photograph, Drawing, Painting and Cartoon are its children.

label: Points of light
definition: One or more points of light that do not create a sense of shape.
hed_note: Nearest tag; Point-light-visualization is the tag for biological-motion displays.

label: Pseudowords
definition: Groups of letters that are meaningless as words.

label: Random dots
definition: A group of many dots, often moving in random or synchronous patterns.

label: Reversed speech
definition: Spoken words or sentences recorded and then played in reverse.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED has no speech item.

label: Shapes
definition: A distinct body characterized by an outline of specific form or figure.
hed_note: Circle, Square, Triangle and the rest are its children; 3D-shape for solids.

label: Syllables
definition: A unit of spoken language consisting of a single uninterrupted sound.

label: Symbols
definition: An arbitrary written or printed sign that conveys meaning, such as a plus sign, arrow or asterisk.
hed_note: Arrow is a Geometric-object; other symbols are glyphs.

label: Tactile stimulation
definition: A class of stimuli perceptible by the sense of touch.
hed_note: No HED item; Tactile-presentation names the modality only.

label: TMS
definition: Transcranial magnetic stimulation.
hed_note: No HED item; out of the Catalog's scope in any case.

label: Tones
definition: One or more musical sounds that individually have a single frequency.

label: Vibratory stimulation
definition: A tactile stimulus that oscillates rhythmically at a given high frequency.
hed_note: An attribute rather than an item.

label: Words
definition: A sound or combination of sounds, or its written representation, that communicates a meaning.

label: Sentences
definition: A grammatical sentence or phrase presented in writing or speech.
hed_note: Exact tag. Added for the Catalog's language tasks (Sentence Comprehension, Self-Paced Reading).

label: Scenes
definition: A photograph or rendering of a natural or built scene.
hed_note: Nearest tag. Added for scene-memory and affective-picture tasks.

label: Monetary amounts
definition: A sum of money offered, won or lost, shown as a number or a symbol.
hed_note: No HED item in 8.4.0. Added for the Catalog's reward and economic tasks.

label: Playing cards
definition: Cards or card-like stimuli sorted, chosen or drawn from decks.
hed_note: No HED item. Added for Wisconsin Card Sorting, Iowa Gambling and Wason Selection.

label: Virtual environment
definition: A navigable rendered environment presented on a screen or in a headset.
hed_note: Devices only; HED has no environment item. Added for the virtual maze tasks.

label: Target
definition: A stimulus that is to be attended to, responded to and distinguished from competing stimuli.

label: Non-target
definition: A stimulus that serves the role of a non-target.

label: Feedback
definition: A stimulus providing knowledge of the performance or results of a previous behavior.

label: Reward
definition: A stimulus that reinforces a desired response.

label: Distractor
definition: A stimulus presented to draw attention away from the target.
hed_note: From HED's Task-stimulus-role vocabulary; CogPO has no distractor role.

label: Cue
definition: A stimulus that signals what is to come or what to do next.

label: Oddball
definition: An infrequent stimulus differing from the frequent standard.

label: Penalty
definition: A stimulus that signals a loss or punishment.

label: Go signal
definition: A stimulus that instructs the participant to respond.

label: Stop signal
definition: A stimulus that instructs the participant to withhold a response already under way.

label: Prime
definition: A stimulus presented to influence the processing of a following stimulus.

label: Novel
definition: A stimulus not previously presented.

label: Hand
definition: Response made with the hand.

label: Foot
definition: Response made with the foot.

label: Mouth
definition: Response made with the mouth.

label: Face
definition: Response made with the face.

label: Arm
definition: Response made with the arm.
hed_note: HED has Upper-arm and Forearm but no Arm; Upper-extremity is the parent.

label: Leg
definition: Response made with the leg.
hed_note: HED has Upper-leg and Lower-leg but no Leg; Lower-extremity is the parent.

label: Shoulder
definition: Response made with the shoulder.

label: Pelvis
definition: Response made with the pelvis.

label: Eye
definition: Response made with the eyes.
hed_note: Exact tag. On the CogPO wiki; not among the OWL's FMA classes.

label: Torso
definition: Response made with the torso.
hed_note: Exact tag. On the CogPO wiki; not among the OWL's FMA classes.

label: Finger
definition: Response made with one or more fingers.
hed_note: Exact tag. Added because the Catalog's manual tasks are mostly finger responses.

label: Button press
definition: To press a button or buttons with the hand or foot.
hed_note: Press is the action; Push-button, Keyboard-key or Mouse-button the device pressed.

label: Saccade
definition: A rapid eye movement from one fixation point to another.

label: Blink
definition: To open and close the eye.

label: Speech
definition: Oral communication; something spoken.

label: Finger tapping
definition: Repetitive adduction and abduction of one or more fingers or thumbs.
hed_note: Nearest tags; HED has no tap action.

label: Point
definition: To direct the finger at, to or upon something.

label: Grasp
definition: To seize and hold by clasping with the fingers.

label: Manipulate
definition: To handle or use skillfully in a process or action.
hed_note: Nearest parent; HED has Touch, Hold-down, Lift and Reach as children.

label: Draw
definition: To compose or create a picture in lines.
hed_note: No HED action; Drawing exists only as an Image item.

label: Write
definition: To trace or form characters, letters or words on a surface.

label: Drink
definition: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.
hed_note: No HED action; Swallow is the nearest.

label: Swallow
definition: To take into the stomach through the throat by voluntary muscular action.

label: Breath hold
definition: Suspension of external breathing.

label: Breathe
definition: To breathe normally.

label: Flexion or extension
definition: Repetitive adduction and abduction of a body part other than the fingers and thumbs (OWL label: Extension).
hed_note: Flex is under Move-body; Move-body-part covers the limb.

label: Micturate
definition: To pass urine.
hed_note: No HED action; out of the Catalog's scope in any case.

label: Smile
definition: To assume a facial expression with the corners of the mouth turned up.

label: Whistle
definition: To make a clear musical sound by expelling breath through the lips.

label: Key press
definition: To press a key on a keyboard or keypad.
hed_note: Added: the Catalog's commonest response device; CogPO folds it into Button Press.

label: Mouse click
definition: To press a button on a computer mouse.
hed_note: Added for choice and rating tasks run on a computer.

label: Touchscreen tap
definition: To touch a location on a touchscreen.

label: Rating
definition: To report a value on a scale, by any device.
hed_note: No HED action; the response is a Participant-response event carrying a value.

label: No response
definition: The participant makes no overt response (passive viewing, listening or rest).
hed_note: Agent-cognitive-state/Passive describes the participant; there is no response event.

label: Attend
definition: To pay attention; to listen or watch attentively.
hed_note: Exact tag (Think/Attend-to). Task-attentional-demand tags qualify the kind of attention.

label: Count
definition: The act of counting, enumerating or calculating.

label: Detect
definition: To discover the existence of; to identify that a specific event has occurred.

label: Discriminate
definition: To make a distinction between; to differentiate.

label: Encode
definition: To store a stimulus into memory for later retrieval.
hed_note: Exact tag; Memorize is the deliberate form.

label: Fixate
definition: To focus the eyes or attention on.

label: Generate
definition: To produce or specify by application of a rule, such as naming as many animals as possible.

label: Imagine
definition: To form mental images of things not present to the senses.
hed_note: Exact tag; Imagined-action is the task-action-type for imagined movement.

label: Move
definition: To execute an action involving a body part.

label: Name
definition: To identify by name; to generate the name of the stimulus.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED has no Name action. The response is Speak.

label: Read
definition: To utter aloud or render in speech written or printed words.

label: Recall
definition: To bring back from memory; to remember.

label: Repeat
definition: To say something again.

label: Rest
definition: To become or remain inactive.
hed_note: Exact tag (Perform/Rest); Resting is the agent state.

label: Sing
definition: To utter words or sounds with musical modulation of the voice.

label: Smile
definition: To assume a smiling facial expression.

label: Track
definition: To observe or follow the course or progress of.

label: Breath hold
definition: To hold one's breath.

label: Breathe
definition: To breathe normally.

label: Judge
definition: To form an opinion or estimate about a stimulus, such as its valence, size or truth.
hed_note: From HED's Think vocabulary; CogPO folds judgements into Discriminate.

label: Recognize
definition: To decide whether a stimulus was encountered before.
hed_note: From HED's Think vocabulary; CogPO uses Recall for recognition tests too.

label: Respond
definition: To make the response the task calls for.

label: Predict
definition: To state what will happen next.
hed_note: From HED's Think vocabulary; needed for the Catalog's learning tasks.

label: Plan
definition: To work out a sequence of moves before acting.
hed_note: From HED's Think vocabulary; needed for Tower of London.

label: Learn
definition: To acquire a rule, sequence or association over trials.

label: Identify
definition: To say what a stimulus is.

label: Switch attention
definition: To move attention between tasks, locations or features.
hed_note: From HED's Think vocabulary; needed for Task Switching.

label: Choose
definition: To select one of several offered options.
hed_note: Nearest tag; HED 8.4.0 has no choose or decide action. Added for the Catalog's decision and economic tasks.

label: Rate
definition: To report a value on a scale.
hed_note: No HED action. Added for the Catalog's rating tasks.

label: Withhold
definition: To refrain from responding on signal.
hed_note: No HED action; Stop-signal and Omitted-action describe the stimulus and the outcome. Added for Go/No-Go and Stop-Signal.

label: Navigate
definition: To find one's way to a goal location.
hed_note: No HED action. Added for the virtual maze tasks.

label: Play
definition: To take part in a game against a partner or the computer.
hed_note: Exact tag (Perform/Play). Added for the economic games.
